item.title: Scalable physical deep learning using optical dynamics with state-skipping training and single-map architecture
item.content:encoded:
Nature Computational Science, Published online: 05 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01075-w

This study presents a scalable, efficient framework for unconventional computing with physical neural networks. It replaces dense connections with uncoupled one-dimensional dynamics, simplifies training, improves performance and reduces resource use.
